title: A Blood Glucose Control Framework Based on Reinforcement Learning With Safety and Interpretability: In Silico Validation
evidence_anchors: Official IEEE Access PDF, DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2021.3100007: pp. 5-9 define the extended state, random-forest glucose transition model, 30-min prediction target, and safe-SAC actions; pp. 12-16 and Tables 3-5 report recursive prediction errors and 20-day closed-loop outcomes; Figs. 6-10 show virtual-subject control and safety behavior.
reviewer_notes: Planning is demonstrated only in the UVA/Padova in-silico environment. Fifty-step imagined trajectories are used for learning, but performance is not reported as a function of rollout horizon. PID guides early training and is a control baseline, not an action-agnostic dynamics comparator. No formal uncertainty calibration or external cohort is reported.

title: A Data-Driven Closed-Loop Control Approach to Drive Neural State Transitions for Mechanistic Insight.
evidence_anchors: PMC13370802 Methods: held-out fMRI reconstruction and closed-loop control; Results Figs. 2-6 report spectra, functional connectivity, target likelihood and control energy; Limitations state one dataset and no empirical stimulation validation; GitHub humml-lab/fmri-control.
reviewer_notes: Planning is demonstrated only inside an individually fitted latent model. Region-restricted controls support action sensitivity, but there is no action-agnostic predictive comparator, formal calibration, external cohort, identified causal estimand, or physiological hazard test. Hyperparameters/model selection used test data in a subset.

title: A Modular Framework to Predict Alzheimer’s Disease Progression Using Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks
evidence_anchors: Primary PDF pp. 3-7; Fig. 3; Sec. V-A/V-B; Fig. 21; DOI 10.1109/IJCNN48605.2020.9206875
reviewer_notes: Visit-stage images and fractal trends are reported, but no held-out patient trajectory, demonstrated full cascade, calibration, baseline, or external test.

title: A World Model of Radiologist Reading for Medical Image Representation Learning
evidence_anchors: Abstract p.1; Sec.3 and Fig.1 pp.3-5; Sec.4 and Tables 1-5 pp.5-9; Limitations p.10; Apps.A-B pp.13-15
reviewer_notes: Direct gaze and downstream task evaluation supports state evidence, but pretraining is teacher-forced and does not establish free-running clinical dynamics.

title: A data-driven Alzheimer's disease progression simulator for retrospective validation and prospective Phase III power design.
evidence_anchors: medRxiv full text, DOI 10.64898/2026.05.03.26352317: Abstract and pp. 2-4 state the six-trial retrospective/prospective design; Results pp. 5-11, Tables 1-2, and Figs. 1-5 report biomarker trajectories, placebo/treatment contrasts, endpoint predictions, and power curves; Methods pp. 14-21 define the VAE-neural-ODE state and amyloid-clearance intervention; pp. 13-14 discuss limitations.
reviewer_notes: The paper implements intervention-conditioned trial simulations and explicit treated-versus-placebo endpoint/power calculations. Trial-specific and leave-one-trial-out calibration means the external trial comparison is not a fully frozen independent validation. Repeated simulations quantify Monte Carlo variation, but no reliability, coverage, or calibration-slope analysis is reported. Public source code is identified in the paper.

title: A digital twin for hospital antimicrobial resistance forecasting and constrained intervention optimisation
evidence_anchors: medRxiv v1 Methods: synthetic hospital, H=7 graph forecasting, matched policy branches and MILP; Results report stress tests, held-out action-ranking accuracy/regret/non-worsening; official predictive and causal GitHub repositories.
reviewer_notes: This is strong within-simulator planning evidence with baseline containment, multiple policy perturbations and constraints. Causal evidence is partial because the estimand and matched random streams are explicit only within an assumed synthetic system; no real-hospital identification or external validation exists. Safety is a constraint/stress proxy, not clinical safety.

title: AKI-twinX: explainable organ structured digital twin for sepsis AKI trajectory forecasting
evidence_anchors: Preprint pp. 16-24; Fig. 2; Fig. 4; Case-based intervention section; DOI 10.64898/2026.03.13.26346736
reviewer_notes: The withdrawal analysis is explicitly a sensitivity probe rather than a causal effect. External IUH evaluation is frozen, but forecasts are one-step and uncalibrated.

title: Action-Conditioned World Model for Goal Plane Probe Guidance in Robotic Ultrasound
evidence_anchors: Sec.II pp.2-4; Table I p.5; Fig.4 and Tables II-IV pp.5-7; Discussion p.8
reviewer_notes: Real closed-loop guidance and zero/inverse-action controls support planning and action evidence. The image model predicts offsets rather than recursively consuming generated images, and force safety is not measured.

title: Affective Music Recommendation: A Rollout-Based World Model for Offline Preference Optimization
evidence_anchors: Abstract p.1; Sec.3 and Fig.1 pp.2-4; Sec.4 and Tables 1-5 pp.5-8; Sec.5.1-5.3 p.8
reviewer_notes: The five-song simulator is free-running and used for offline optimization, but utility is evaluated inside the learned simulator. Counterfactual-history wording lacks causal identification.

title: Agentifying Patient Dynamics within LLMs through Interacting with Clinical World Model
evidence_anchors: Abstract and Secs.2-3 pp.1-5; Tables 3-4 pp.8-9; Apps.C-F pp.15-18; Apps.I-J pp.23-24
reviewer_notes: Planning is evaluated with model rollouts and OPE, including unsafe-action review, but transition fidelity is mainly one-step and causal identification, overlap, and calibrated uncertainty are incomplete.

title: Arti-JEPA: Adapting Video World Model to Real-Time MRI of the Vocal Tract for Speech-Production Analysis
evidence_anchors: Abstract pp.1-2; Sec.3 pp.3-5; Sec.4 pp.6-9; clinical evaluations pp.10-15; Limitations p.16; Appendix pp.19-25
reviewer_notes: Masked representation prediction and probes provide indirect temporal evidence, not a free-running clinical trajectory simulator. Audio conditioning was not an effective action channel.

title: Autosomal Dominant Tubulointerstitial Kidney Disease Clinical Trial Simulator: Case Reports of Model-Informed Drug Development.
evidence_anchors: Clinical and Translational Science full text, DOI 10.1002/psp4.70258: Methods sections 'Development of the CTS tool' and 'Clinical trial simulations' describe the UMOD/MUC1 registry models, synthetic cohorts, placebo and treatment parameter changes, durations, and 100 replicates; Results case reports and associated figures/tables report power across effect sizes and trial designs; Discussion states assumptions and validation limits; Data S1 supplies selected code examples.
reviewer_notes: Alternative assumed treatment effects are simulated against placebo to support trial-design decisions. The disease models have prior test/VPC support, but intervention response is hypothetical rather than clinically validated, and no confounding or overlap analysis supports causal interpretation. The public Shiny interface and snippets aid inspection but do not constitute a complete downloadable analysis repository.

title: BLINK: Behavioral Latent Modeling of NK Cell Cytotoxicity
evidence_anchors: Methods pp.3-5; dataset protocol p.6; Table 1 p.7; Fig.3 p.8
reviewer_notes: A 30-step free latent forecast supports dynamics, but there is no horizon-resolved drift analysis. The no-action ablation is limited, and motion is observed rather than an intervention.

title: Brain-WM: Brain Glioblastoma World Model
evidence_anchors: Abstract and Fig.1 p.1; Sec.III pp.2-5; Tables I-II pp.5-6; Figs.4-7 and Tables III-IV pp.7-9
reviewer_notes: The paper claims a counterfactual sandbox, but evidence is one observed next-treatment/next-MRI transition without alternative-treatment ground truth or confounding adjustment.

title: CLARITY: Medical World Model for Guiding Treatment Decisions by Modeling Context-Aware Disease Trajectories in Latent Space
evidence_anchors: Methods/rollout pp.5-10; datasets p.10; Tables 1-6 and Figs.5-6 pp.11-15; Appendix pp.19-24
reviewer_notes: Recursive candidate-treatment planning is shown, but no horizon-resolved rollout fidelity or causal identification supports optimal-treatment claims. UCSF is a frozen zero-shot component test; expert review is small.

title: CalTwin: Towards Calibrated, Shift-Robust Medical World Models via Fisher-Information Regularisation
evidence_anchors: Abstract and Secs.1-2 pp.1-4; Sec.3 pp.4-7; Sec.4 Tables 1-2 and Figs.1-2 pp.7-10; Secs.5-6 pp.11-12
reviewer_notes: ECE and reliability analysis support formal calibration, and held-out hospitals support frozen external evidence. The authors explicitly report teacher-forced next-step evaluation only.

title: CardamomOT: a mechanistic optimal transport-based framework for gene regulatory network inference, trajectory reconstruction and generative modeling
evidence_anchors: Accessible bioRxiv v2 abstract; official GitHub README/docs; experimental_datasets Schiebinger, Semrau and Kameneva; article result scripts figure3.py-figure8.py; wild-type, KO, partial-KO, overexpression, stimulus and weights artifacts. bioRxiv PDF/XML returned HTTP 429 repeatedly on 2026-09-12.
reviewer_notes: Full-text-only sample totals, exact metric definitions, inferential tests and causal assumptions are NI because of HTTP 429. Scores rely on the accessible abstract and official executable artifacts. Multiple real datasets are fitted separately, so external evidence is limited and not frozen. No formal uncertainty calibration, decision task or safety test was verifiable.

title: Cardiac Copilot: Automatic Probe Guidance for Echocardiography with World Model
evidence_anchors: Abstract and Introduction pp.1-3; Sec.2 and Fig.2 pp.4-6; Sec.3 Table 1 and Fig.3 pp.6-8
reviewer_notes: The paper claims guidance/planning, but evidence is single-step offline pose prediction in one healthy cohort. No closed-loop execution, state fidelity, uncertainty, safety, or external validation is shown.

title: CellPace: A temporal diffusion-forcing framework for simulation, interpolation and forecasting of single-cell dynamics
evidence_anchors: Preprint Figs. 1-5; pp. 23-30 Methods; stage-holdout, metrics, and Software/Data Availability sections; DOI 10.64898/2026.02.25.707938
reviewer_notes: Strong stage-resolved interpolation and extrapolation with public code/data. Stochastic samples are not calibrated and cross-sectional cells cannot validate individual-cell paths.

title: Chreode: A Cell World Model for One-Step Temporal Dynamics and Perturbation Prediction
evidence_anchors: Secs. 3-5 and Tables 1-4; Sec. 7; Apps. A.4, E, and I
reviewer_notes: The action-conditioned claim is supported by architecture and perturbation transfer, but developmental pretraining uses a null action and no action-removal, shuffle, dose, or causal test. Frozen external validation refers only to the zero-shot Weinreb fate analysis; the time-transition and GEARS tasks involve downstream training.

title: ChronoMedicalWorld: A Medical World Model for Learning Patient Trajectories from Longitudinal Care Data
evidence_anchors: Abstract p.1; Sec.2.4 pp.3-4; Sec.3 and Fig.1 pp.4-6; Sec.4 Tables 1-3 pp.6-8; Sec.5 Tables 4-5 pp.8-9; Sec.6 p.10
reviewer_notes: Free-running multiyear prediction is evaluated, but the what-if/counterfactual interface is explicitly not a causal estimator. Action tests vary channels and intensity without an action-agnostic causal comparator.

title: Clin-JEPA: A Multi-Phase Co-Training Framework for Joint-Embedding Predictive Pretraining on EHR Patient Trajectories
evidence_anchors: Secs. 3.1-3.2; Secs. 5.1-5.4 and Figs. 2-4; App. A; linked GitHub repository
reviewer_notes: The model consumes observed intervention text and claims proposed-action rollout, but action influence is not isolated. Rollout evidence is strong for latent fidelity, although predictions are not decoded to clinical measurements and all experiments use MIMIC-IV.

title: Control of Magnetic Surgical Robots With Model-Based Simulators and Reinforcement Learning.
evidence_anchors: IEEE Transactions on Medical Robotics and Bionics full text, DOI 10.1109/TMRB.2022.3214426: Sections II-B-II-D define the 34,742-transition physical dataset, state/action space, learned simulator, 5-30-step recursive episodes, and TD3 training; Section III and Figs. 4-7 compare validation/test loss and real-robot center, random-target, and square trajectories; safety-related reset, cooling, and dead-zone constraints appear in the methods and discussion.
reviewer_notes: A learned transition model is used to plan/control a physical magnetic robot, followed by frozen real-hardware evaluation. Recursive training is demonstrated, but no horizon-resolved degradation or uncertainty analysis is provided. Safety evidence concerns hardware constraints and overheating/dead-zone handling, not tissue or patient safety. No code or dataset release was found in the full text.

title: Cosmos-H-Surgical: Learning Surgical Robot Policies from Videos via World Modeling
evidence_anchors: Abstract and links p.1; Sec.3 pp.4-5; Sec.4 Tables 1-2 and Figs.4-8 pp.5-9; Supplement pp.12-15
reviewer_notes: Policy-learning is the highest claim, but the video model is not kinematic-action conditioned and evidence stops at offline trajectory MSE. Expert consistency/hallucination review is only a limited safety proxy.

title: CrossScope: A Role-Asymmetric World Model for Joint Dual-Scope Surgical Video Prediction
evidence_anchors: Benchmark overview p.2; Methods pp.3-5; Tables 1-2 and Fig.6 pp.5-7; Appendix Tables 4-10 pp.11-15
reviewer_notes: The geometric trajectory is a visual conditioning proxy, not a commanded operator action. Eight-frame windows are independently predicted and explicitly not chained autoregressively.

title: DITTO: A Visual Digital Twin for Interventions and Temporal Treatment Outcomes in Head and Neck Cancer.
evidence_anchors: arXiv:2407.13107 pp. 3-4 and Appendix pp. 12-16 describe the cohort, 389/147 split, three treatment stages, transition and survival metrics, MC-dropout intervals and limitations; Figs. 5-8 and clinician case studies evaluate the interface.
reviewer_notes: Clinician workflow evaluation warrants decision evidence 2, but it is an offline prototype rather than prospective utility. Propensity matching and counterfactual displays provide partial causal evidence without an explicit estimand, overlap checks or complete censoring handling. No public code/data path was located; main text and appendix disagree on total n.

title: DRIFT: Direct-Recursive Intervention-Conditioned Forecasting of ICU Physiological Trajectories
evidence_anchors: Secs. 3-5 and Table 1; Sec. 6; Apps. B-D, G.1, and H
reviewer_notes: The recursive path consumes its own latent state and the combined forecast is evaluated by horizon, but it is a bounded auxiliary correction rather than an independently decoded simulator. Donor-path replacement measures input dependence and is explicitly not counterfactual validation. eICU uses independent retraining, so external evidence is adapted rather than frozen.

title: Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Malaria Control
evidence_anchors: Problem and method pp.1-4; theorem pp.4-5; Table 1 and Fig.4 pp.5-6
reviewer_notes: Closed-loop policy search is evaluated in defined simulators with public code. GP variance drives exploration but is not calibrated, and there is no field transport, mismatch stress, or deployment-safety analysis.

title: Deep Generative Model of Macrophage Immune Response for Hepato-intestinal Tumor Therapy Optimization.
evidence_anchors: Europe PMC PMCID PMC13505573: Introduction, cohort, completeness, deployment, and architecture sections; DOI 10.34133/cbsystems.0559
reviewer_notes: Public primary XML ends mid-Methods and publisher PDF was inaccessible. Codes after that boundary are conservative; the nonrandomized outcome comparison does not identify treatment effects.

title: Development of a model-based clinical trial simulation platform to optimize the design of clinical trials for Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
evidence_anchors: Clinical and Translational Science full text, DOI 10.1002/psp4.12753: Methods and Table 1 describe 15 studies, 1,505 participants, 27,252 observations, five outcomes, model-building and four non-US validation datasets; model-development and simulation sections define NLME trajectories, covariates, missing timed-test observations, placebo and hypothetical treatment scenarios; Results and Figs. 2-5 report internal and external VPCs; Appendix S5 contains model code.
reviewer_notes: The longitudinal disease models receive genuinely independent non-US validation, and the platform can vary treatment timing and magnitude. However, the article mainly validates natural-history models and describes the simulation platform; it does not report a prospective decision-impact study or a clearly defined causal treatment estimand. Hypothetical treatment effects are assumptions, so causal evidence remains limited.

title: Digital twin brain simulator for real-time consciousness monitoring and virtual intervention using primate electrocorticogram data
evidence_anchors: PMC11811282 Methods: leave-one-animal-out ECoG training, online data assimilation and z1/z2/z3 virtual interventions; Figs. 2-5 and Table 1 report prediction, latent organization and intervention classification; public h-idei/pvrnn_sa code.
reviewer_notes: Held-out animals are adapted through data assimilation, so external evidence is 1 rather than frozen validation. Stochastic latent sampling is an uncertainty proxy without calibration. Interventions are latent manipulations with no real action comparator, physiological dose validation, decision outcome or safety test.

title: Digital twin models for predicting venetoclax and azacitidine-induced neutropenia in patients with acute myeloid leukemia.
evidence_anchors: Primary article Figs. 1-3; Model fitting; Data from multiple cycles; Parameter update; Statistical analysis; Code/Data availability; DOI 10.1038/s41746-025-01978-4
reviewer_notes: Patient-specific ODE rollouts are tested over short and long horizons with public code. No external cohort, formal calibration, or validated alternative-dose effect is provided.

title: DreamReg: Belief-Driven World Model for 2D-3D Ultrasound Registration
evidence_anchors: Abstract p.1; Sec.2 and Figs.1-2 pp.3-6; Sec.3 and Tables 1-2 pp.6-8; Conclusion p.9
reviewer_notes: Closed-loop imagined registration is demonstrated in synthetic slice rendering. Final registration supports task utility, but stepwise rollout drift, calibrated uncertainty, and live safety are absent.

title: ECG-WM: A Physiology-Informed ECG World Model for Clinical Intervention Simulation
evidence_anchors: Abstract and Secs.1-4 pp.1-5; Sec.5 Tables 1-4 pp.6-9; Sec.6 pp.9-10; Apps.A-B pp.13-19
reviewer_notes: Autoregressive horizon and stress tests are strong, with frozen ICU transfer. Candidate-drug comparisons and risk ranking still lack an explicit causal estimand, support analysis, or randomized individualized validation.

title: EHRWorld: A Patient-Centric Medical World Model for Long-Horizon Clinical Trajectories
evidence_anchors: Abstract pp.1-2; Sec.3 and Fig.2 pp.3-4; Sec.4 pp.4-5 and Algorithm 1 p.13; Sec.5 Tables 1-2 pp.5-8; Limitations p.9
reviewer_notes: Full trajectories are generated and compared with next-event performance, but causal and counterfactual wording exceeds observed-policy prediction. No action sensitivity, calibration, or external validation is reported.

title: EchoWorld: Learning Motion-Aware World Models for Echocardiography Probe Guidance
evidence_anchors: Abstract p.1; Secs.3-4 and Fig.4 pp.3-6; Sec.5 Tables 1-3 pp.6-8; supplement pp.12-14
reviewer_notes: Motion-removal/component ablations support action dependence, but imagined image fidelity is qualitative and guidance is direct offline prediction, not recursive closed-loop control.

title: EyeWorld: A Generative World Model of Ocular State and Dynamics
evidence_anchors: Data overview pp.5-7; longitudinal synthesis Fig.7 pp.16-18; counterfactual edits Fig.8 pp.19-21; Limitations and Methods pp.24-31
reviewer_notes: Prompt-edited pathology images motivate a counterfactual claim, but there is no intervention model, alternative-outcome ground truth, recursive rollout, or frozen longitudinal external test.

title: Failure Detection for Surgical Robot Imitation Policies via Flow-Matching World Modeling
evidence_anchors: Abstract p.1; Fig.1 p.2; Sec.III pp.3-4; Sec.IV and Table I pp.4-6; Figs.5-6 p.7; Limitations p.8
reviewer_notes: Conformal thresholds and strong no-action/component controls support calibration and action evidence. Detection is offline and does not test interruption, recovery, or clinical harm severity.

title: Future Querying: Can LLMs Serve as Implicit Medical World Models?
evidence_anchors: Abstract and Secs.1-4 pp.1-4; Secs.5.1-5.3 pp.5-6; Secs.5.4-6 pp.7-8
reviewer_notes: Semantic answers to isolated future queries are an indirect state/dynamics proxy. They do not establish coherent trajectories, free-running rollout, calibration, or decision utility.

title: GEMEO: the first patient world model for rare disease, grounding generative clinical trajectories in the genome and a biomedical knowledge graph
evidence_anchors: Abstract p.1; Sec.2 pp.2-3; Sec.3 Tables 1-3 pp.3-6; Sec.4 p.6; Methods and limitations pp.7-8
reviewer_notes: Current evidence supports prediction and actual-versus-masked treatment association. Level-3 counterfactual capability is prospective rather than demonstrated; external partition and calibration-method details remain sparse.

title: Generating whole-brain neural activity and behavior through unified latent dynamics
evidence_anchors: bioRxiv v2 full text, DOI 10.64898/2026.06.05.730482: Results sections on latent dynamics and generative modeling report a 109-neuron single-animal recording, 30,000-step free generation, 1,000 60-s rollouts, behavioral/transition-distribution tests, and connectivity reconstruction; perturbation and steering sections report global/local noise and targeted behavioral steering; Methods define the encoder, stochastic transition, recurrent decoders, and evaluation.
reviewer_notes: Long free-running generation and structured latent perturbations are empirically tested, but all fitting and distributional comparison use one immobilized C. elegans recording without held-out animals. Targeted steering is a model-space intervention, not validated biological causation. State-dependent stochasticity is modeled without formal predictive calibration. No paper-specific public code or processed data release was identified.

title: Intervention-Aware Clinical World Model for Post-Op Outcome Forecasting in Cardiology
evidence_anchors: Methods and Table 1 pp.3-5; Tables 2-4 and Fig.3 pp.6-7; Fig.4 and Limitations p.8
reviewer_notes: ECE plus event removal, shuffling, timing, and presence edits strongly test predictive dependence. The study explicitly disclaims causal effects and does not free-run treatment-policy trajectories.

title: Koopman-based linearization of preparatory EEG dynamics in Parkinson's disease during galvanic vestibular stimulation.
evidence_anchors: PMC12116581 Methods: subject-level six-fold CV, Deep Koopman and LQR; Fig. 4 reports NMSE through 15 prediction steps; Fig. 8 compares controlled and uncontrolled latent trajectories; official DeepKoopman_PD repository includes code and sample data.
reviewer_notes: Horizon-resolved multi-step prediction supports rollout evidence 2. LQR is evaluated only as abstract latent identity control, so action and decision evidence remain limited. Bounded control is a safety proxy without physiological constraints or adverse-event testing. Full EEG is request-based and no external cohort exists.

title: Learning Emotional Dynamics: A World Model Approach
evidence_anchors: Abstract and Secs.2.4-4.2 pp.1 and 4-8; Secs.4.4-4.8 pp.12-19; Secs.5.2-6 pp.22-23; code p.32
reviewer_notes: Twenty-step free-running emotion forecasts are evaluated. The paper's causal claim from conditioning-source comparison lacks an intervention, causal design, or explicit estimand; split and horizon interpretation need adjudication.

title: Learning Temporal Basis Vectors for Closed-Loop Neural Stimulation.
evidence_anchors: Detailed preprint pp. 4-12 and 20-25; Table 1; Fig. 12; Appendix 6.1-6.3; EMBC DOI 10.1109/EMBC58623.2025.11254522
reviewer_notes: Direct multistep forecasts and simulated controllers are evaluated with action/no-action data. The loop is not in vivo, uncertainty is uncalibrated, and data are request-based.

title: MRI Contrast Enhancement Kinetics World Model
evidence_anchors: Abstract and Sec.1 pp.1-2; Sec.3 pp.3-5; Sec.4.1 and Table 1 pp.5-7; supplementary kinetics figures pp.13-17
reviewer_notes: Time-conditioned image generation and adjacent-frame continuity directly assess kinetics, but generation is not autoregressive. Split details, uncertainty, and reader utility are not reported.

title: Machine Learning for Mechanical Ventilation Control
evidence_anchors: Author arXiv v4 full text corresponding to DOI 10.1101/2021.02.26.21252524: Sections 2-3 define QuickLung physical testing, six resistance/compliance settings, pressure/control histories, learned simulators, randomized valve perturbations, and residual-PID control; simulator-evaluation figures report recursive open-loop error through 30 steps; controller figures compare learned control with grid-searched PID on physical ventilators; safety overrides and pneumatic protections are described in the experimental setup.
reviewer_notes: The learned simulator supports controller optimization and the resulting controller is evaluated closed loop on real bench hardware across six lung settings. Action variation is present in data collection, but there is no action-agnostic model comparator, uncertainty analysis, or clinical/patient validation. The ventilator platform is open source, while the paper-specific learning code and datasets were not clearly released.

title: Medical World Model
evidence_anchors: Abstract and Fig.1 p.1; Sec.3 Figs.2-3 and Algorithm 1 pp.3-6; Sec.4 Tables 1-3 and Figs.4-7 pp.6-8
reviewer_notes: Candidate-regimen simulation and assistant planning are retrospective and one-step. Factual-regimen images do not validate alternative-treatment outcomes; the external cohort is adapted before testing.

title: Model-based reinforcement learning for ultrasound-driven autonomous microrobots.
evidence_anchors: Figs. 2-6; Methods sections on RL and world-model learning; Discussion; Data and Code Availability
reviewer_notes: Closed-loop physical control and explicit collision, overshoot, loss-of-view recovery, and flow stress tests support decision and safety evidence at the artificial-platform stage. Dynamics fidelity is indirect because the world model is judged mainly through learning and control rather than held-out transition prediction.

title: Modelling neural coding in the auditory midbrain with high resolution and accuracy.
evidence_anchors: PMC12460167 Results Figs. 1-5 and Methods: unseen sounds, held-out animals, response-distribution metrics and neurophysiology tests; Data/Code Availability; official ICNet repository provides pretrained weights and executable notebook.
reviewer_notes: ICNet is a high-quality stimulus-conditioned observation model, not a recursive state-transition rollout. New-animal transfer fits a decoder, so it is adapted external evidence. Predictive distributions and bootstrap CIs lack formal calibration. ASR is a downstream probe, not clinical decision utility.

title: Multi-Objective Model-based Reinforcement Learning for Infectious Disease Control
evidence_anchors: ArXiv 2009.04607 v3: Secs. 3-5; Figs. 4-6; Appendix C.1-C.4
reviewer_notes: Long Monte Carlo rollouts, prediction bands, policy baselines, and leave-one-city-out validation are present. Intervention effects remain observational and prior-driven without confounding or overlap analysis.

title: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams: Real-Time Generative Physics Simulation for Surgical Robotics
evidence_anchors: Abstract and links p.1; Secs.1-3 pp.3-5; Sec.4 pp.6-8; Secs.5-6 Tables 1-4 and Figs.3-5 pp.9-12; Limitations p.14
reviewer_notes: Long autoregressive video and retrospective real-policy ranking support simulator evidence, but no systematic action perturbation or calibrated uncertainty is reported and some tasks rank policies negatively.

title: NeuroWorld: A Latent Brain World Model for Stimulus-Conditioned Human Brain Dynamics
evidence_anchors: Abstract p.1; Sec.III and Fig.3 pp.3-5; Sec.IV Tables I-III pp.5-8; Discussion pp.9-10
reviewer_notes: The model free-runs to 20, 50, and 100 TR with direct forecast metrics. Stimuli are observed conditioning streams, and causal wording refers to past-only attention rather than intervention effects.

title: Nonstationary Battery
evidence_anchors: Zenodo draft Abstract and Sec.1; Sec.2 Tables B1-B3; Sec.4 caveats; Zenodo file/status record
reviewer_notes: Closed-loop adaptation is measured across designed shifts, but the Markdown-only draft lacks code, result artifacts, and a fair equal-information comparator. Task outcomes indirectly evidence state quality.

title: OMG-RL:Offline Model-based Guided Reward Learning for Heparin Treatment
evidence_anchors: Author arXiv v2 full text for the matching OMG-RL study, arXiv:2409.13299; journal successor DOI 10.1016/j.bea.2025.100198: data/method sections define 1,911 MIMIC-III heparin patients, hourly preprocessing, 16-variable states, six dose actions, an ensemble probabilistic transition model, and 36-step simulated trajectories; experiment tables/figures compare offline-RL baselines, clinicians, WIS estimates, and simulated treatment success over repeated runs.
reviewer_notes: The study learns a sequential dosing policy, but model validity is inferred mainly from offline policy metrics and simulated success rather than direct transition-error or prospective clinical evaluation. The observational clinician-action data are not accompanied by a causal estimand, confounding adjustment, or overlap diagnostics. Ensemble variation is not calibrated. No public implementation or trained weights were identified.

title: Open-H-Embodiment: A Large-Scale Dataset for Enabling Foundation Models in Medical Robotics
evidence_anchors: Abstract pp.1-2; Results pp.7-9 and Table 1; C-H-S-S pp.18-22 and Fig.7; Methods pp.25-29; Data Availability p.36
reviewer_notes: Action-replayed free-running chunks, drift analysis, and policy task success support strong empirical coverage. The evaluation remains open-loop with respect to action selection and lacks a formal simulator-hazard protocol.

title: Optimized glycemic control of type 2 diabetes with reinforcement learning: a proof-of-concept trial.
evidence_anchors: PMC10579102 Fig. 1 and Extended Data Fig. 1 define recurrent K=7 planning; Figs. 2-4 report frozen internal/external prediction and policy tests; Methods and Extended Data describe physician review, deployment, 16-patient trial, hazards, override and statistics; code/model/data package is public.
reviewer_notes: Strongest evidence in the batch for external, real decision and safety evaluation. Rollout is one day at fixed K=7, with no multi-horizon degradation or formal calibration. WIS and the single-arm trial support only partial causal validity; no explicit target-policy estimand or complete time-varying-confounding/overlap analysis is reported.

title: Policy4OOD: A Knowledge-Guided World Model for Policy Intervention Simulation against the Opioid Overdose Crisis
evidence_anchors: Dataset and Table 1 pp.3-4; Method pp.5-7; Tables 2-3 pp.7-8; Figs.4-5 pp.9-10
reviewer_notes: MCTS and explicit advance/replace/remove scenarios support planning and action tests. The paper defines policy contrasts but states predictions are noncausal; confounding, overlap, interference, and observed policy outcomes are absent.

title: Predictive modeling of hemodynamics during viscerosensory neurostimulation via neural computation mechanism in the brainstem.
evidence_anchors: Primary article Figs. 1-7; pp. 12-18 Methods, H-BIND, cross-validation, NMPC, statistics, and availability; DOI 10.1038/s41746-025-01635-w
reviewer_notes: Mechanistic closed-loop simulations include open-loop and stability comparisons with public code/data. Evidence is limited to ten anesthetized rats and lacks in-vivo closed-loop validation.

title: Progressive Experience Fusion for Multi-Task World Model Control in Endovascular Navigation
evidence_anchors: Abstract and Sec.II-B pp.1-3; Secs.II-C-II-F pp.3-7; Sec.II-G Tables I-IV pp.7-10; Discussion pp.10-11
reviewer_notes: Closed-loop phantom navigation provides direct task-state and decision evidence, but learned-transition fidelity is not reported. Dispersion is an uncalibrated proxy and safety coverage is limited to constraints and failures.

title: SAW: Toward a Surgical Action World Model via Controllable and Scalable Video Generation
evidence_anchors: Abstract p.1; Sec.2 and Fig.1 pp.2-4; Sec.3 Tables 1-2 pp.4-6; Sec.4 Table 3 pp.6-9; Conclusion p.10
reviewer_notes: Trajectory-removal and component ablations support action dependence, but video is generated in one shot from a supplied path. No closed loop, calibrated uncertainty, physical safety, or decision utility is tested.

title: SWoMo: Neuro-Symbolic World Model for Cataract Surgery Simulation
evidence_anchors: Abstract p.1; Sec.2 and Fig.2 pp.3-6; Sec.3 Tables 1-2 pp.6-8; Conclusion p.9
reviewer_notes: Rule-based actions condition generated surgical video and clips can be chained, but long-horizon drift and physical constraint violations are not measured. Decision evidence is limited to augmentation/probes.

title: SimulAD: a dynamical model for personalized simulation and disease staging in Alzheimer's disease.
evidence_anchors: Neurobiology of Aging final article, DOI 10.1016/j.neurobiolaging.2021.12.015: Methods describe 442 ADNI source participants, 93 independent Geneva Memory Center participants, multimodal biomarker preprocessing, ODE dynamics, and personalized forward/backward five-year trajectories; Results and Figs. 2-6 report stage separation, biomarker associations, external-cohort application, trajectory errors, and individual MMSE forecasts; sensitivity analyses address preprocessing choices.
reviewer_notes: This article empirically supports passive disease staging and forecasting, including application of an ADNI-derived model to an independent Geneva cohort. It does not evaluate an action or intervention in this study, despite citing earlier treatment-simulation work. Error and sensitivity analyses are reported without formal uncertainty calibration. Code, weights, and the private clinical cohort were not publicly released.

title: Simulating clinical interventions with a generative multimodal model of human physiology
evidence_anchors: Claims and cohorts pp.2-4; Figs.2-4 pp.6-12; Figs.5-6 pp.14-20; Methods pp.28-33 and pp.42-49; Data/Code p.50
reviewer_notes: The paper explicitly disclaims a causal/counterfactual engine, so intervention-token simulations are coded action-conditioned. Frozen cohort tests and active-control/dose comparisons are strong, but horizon queries are not recursive rollouts.

title: Simulating the outcome of amyloid treatments in Alzheimer's disease from imaging and clinical data.
evidence_anchors: PMC8168944 Methods: 442-person ADNI cohort, latent ODE and intervention definition; Figs. 3-7 and Table 2 compare placebo with 50%/100% lowering across intervention years and sample sizes; Discussion states a conditional causal interpretation and cautions about unmodeled mechanisms; supplement link could not be retrieved.
reviewer_notes: Action evidence is strong because dose and timing are explicitly perturbed against natural progression. Causal evidence remains partial: effects are generated from assumed ODE structure without treatment-confounding identification. Independent-cohort validation concerns disease severity rather than intervention response, and frozen status was not verifiable because the supplement was inaccessible. No code or hazard model.

title: Sonata: A Hybrid World Model for Inertial Kinematics under Clinical Data Scarcity
evidence_anchors: Abstract and Secs.1-3 pp.1-5; Sec.4 pp.5-8; Secs.5-6 Tables 2-4 pp.8-12; Appendix pp.16-18
reviewer_notes: Evidence is one-step passive forecasting and representation transfer; action-conditioned and counterfactual wording is not operationalized. Cross-dataset and cross-age tests provide frozen external evidence.

title: Structure-aware World Model for Probe Guidance via Large-scale Self-supervised Pre-train
evidence_anchors: ArXiv 2406.19756 v2 pp. 3-8; Sec. 2.2; Sec. 3.1; Table 1; Fig. 4
reviewer_notes: The 2D-only objective removes pose conditioning and supports action evidence. World-model dynamics are evaluated only indirectly through one-step downstream guidance on same-source scans.

title: Surg-UniWorld: A Unified Surgical World Model with Multimodal Control Experts
evidence_anchors: Abstract and Secs.I-III pp.1-3; Sec.IV-V.A pp.3-7; Sec.V.B-D and Sec.VI pp.8-10
reviewer_notes: Multimodal controls and video/geometry metrics support action-conditioned dynamics. Entire future control sequences are supplied, so this is not autonomous or free-running closed-loop control.

title: SurgVista: Long-Horizon Surgical World Modeling with Plausible Instrument-Tissue Dynamics
evidence_anchors: Introduction/formulation pp.1-3; Methods pp.4-6; Benchmark pp.6-7; Tables 1-5 pp.8-9
reviewer_notes: Explicit 80- versus 800-frame self-fed evaluation supports rollout evidence. Split/adaptation provenance is insufficient for frozen external coding, and actions omit force/contact with no safety test.

title: SurgWMBench: A Vision-Based Benchmark for World-Modeling Surgical Instrument Motion Planning
evidence_anchors: Abstract and Introduction pp.1-4; Sec.3 pp.4-5; Sec.4 Tables 1-2 pp.7-9; Appendix pp.12-15
reviewer_notes: Observed 2D trajectories are forecast rather than commanded actions, so the benchmark is coded passive despite planning motivation. Autoregressive error is reported at 5, 10, and 15 steps.

title: Surgical Procedural Planning as 3D World Modelling: Towards Automated Pulmonary Resection
evidence_anchors: Abstract p.1; Sec.3 and Figs.2-4 pp.2-5; explicit no-post-resection-simulation statement p.5; Tables 1-3 pp.6-8
reviewer_notes: The paper claims causal consequence-aware planning, but explicitly does not simulate post-resection anatomy. Retrospective plan matching and safety-module ablation do not validate counterfactual outcomes or execution.

title: Surgical Vision World Model
evidence_anchors: Methods and data pp.3-5; Results Figs.2-3 and Table 2 pp.6-8; Conclusion p.9
reviewer_notes: Autoregressive video fidelity is reported at two, four, and six frames. Random latent-action comparison tests sensitivity, but latent actions lack semantic or physical grounding and no utility or safety test is present.

title: Surgical WAM: A World-Action Model for Data-Efficient Surgical Robot Learning
evidence_anchors: Abstract pp.1-2; Sec.3 and Fig.2 pp.4-5; Sec.4 Tables 1-3 and Fig.3 pp.5-8; Conclusion pp.7-8
reviewer_notes: Receding-horizon replanning supports simulated closed-loop utility. Direct state and transition fidelity, uncertainty, real-robot quantitative evaluation, and safety tests are missing.

title: The Coupled Stochastic Dynamical System: A Generative Model for Simulating and Forecasting Youth Mental Health Trajectories
evidence_anchors: medRxiv full text, DOI 10.64898/2026.07.26.26358943: Abstract and model overview describe the coupled trait, burden, behavior, physiology, and observation processes; cohort/method sections report GLOBEM N=496, four clusters, the 200-person detailed evaluation, particle inference, and repeated simulations; validation figures/tables report occupancy, transition, target-corridor, and 1/3/7/14/21-day forecasting against persistence/prefix-mean nulls with subject-block bootstrap intervals; limitations discuss held-out design and absent external validation.
reviewer_notes: The architecture is explicitly intended for intervention and counterfactual simulation, but the current empirical batch validates passive simulation/forecasting only; no administered-action response or causal estimand is tested. Horizon-resolved forecasts and uncertainty intervals are substantial, yet reported calibration R-squared plots do not meet the rubric's formal reliability/coverage criterion. Code release is prospective, and data require application.

title: Toward Safe Autonomous Robotic Endovascular Interventions using World Models
evidence_anchors: Methods and data pp.2-4; Tables I-II p.5; Results pp.5-6; Limitations/Safety pp.6-7
reviewer_notes: Physical closed-loop trials, tip force threshold, and failure categories support decision and safety evidence. Direct learned-model transition error and uncertainty fallback are not evaluated.

title: Toward World Modeling of Physiological Signals with Chaos-Theoretic Balancing and Latent Dynamics
evidence_anchors: Abstract p.1; Sec.3 and Table 1 pp.3-5; Secs.3.5-4 pp.5-10; Appendix Tables 4-6 pp.13-14; Table 10 p.25
reviewer_notes: Free-running long/short-horizon signal metrics are reported. Counterfactual and action-awareness claims rely on observational conditioning and qualitative channel replacement without ground-truth alternative outcomes.

title: Towards Causality-Aware Inferring: A Sequential Discriminative Approach for Medical Diagnosis.
evidence_anchors: arXiv:2003.06534v5 pp. 1-10, Tables 1-7 and Figs. 7-10 report counterfactual-answer metrics, closed-loop diagnosis, ablations, OOD and cross-dataset transfer; Appendix pp. 11-19 gives potential-outcome assumptions, training, human evaluation and limitations; CAMAD code is public.
reviewer_notes: The method plans sequential inquiries in a simulator and defines individual potential symptom responses, but does not identify effects on real clinical outcomes. Cross-dataset transfer uses semantic remapping and is not frozen. Bootstrap confidence drives stopping without formal calibration; conservative stopping and human override are discussed without a clinical harm/severity test.

title: Towards Surgical World-Action Modeling: A Preliminary Joint Visual-Trajectory Forecasting for Surgical Motion Planning
evidence_anchors: Secs. 2-3, Table 1, and Sec. 4; qualitative-results repository
reviewer_notes: Despite the world-action label and motion-planning motivation, the model receives no exogenous action or robot command; it passively forecasts future visual states and observed instrument trajectories. The qualitative repository is not a verified implementation of training and evaluation.

title: Treatment-aware Diffusion Probabilistic Model for Longitudinal MRI Generation and Diffuse Glioma Growth Prediction
evidence_anchors: Abstract and Sec.I pp.1-2; Secs.III-IV pp.5-10; Tables I-III and Figs.3-10; Limitations pp.12-13
reviewer_notes: Treatment conditioning and external-hospital image prediction are strong, but direct conditional generation is not self-fed. Alternative-treatment claims lack confounding, overlap, or randomized counterfactual validation.

title: Type 1 diabetes prevention clinical trial simulator: Case reports of model-informed drug development tool.
evidence_anchors: Primary PMC article: Introduction; GUI sections; Case Studies I-II; Impact assessment; Figs. 1-4; DOI 10.1002/psp4.13193
reviewer_notes: The placebo arm and drug-effect slider support action sensitivity, but drug effects are imposed rather than estimated and this paper adds no trajectory calibration or prospective decision validation.

title: World Model Enhanced Offline Reinforcement Learning for Sequential Intervention Optimization in Acute Kidney Injury
evidence_anchors: Abstract p.1; Sec.3 pp.4-7; Sec.4 Tables 1-3 pp.7-10; Discussion pp.11-12; Data Availability p.13
reviewer_notes: One-step model error and uncertainty proxies are reported, but no free-running physiology audit or calibration. Policy-value and rule-violation results use retrospective OPE without confounding or overlap analysis.

title: World Models for General Surgical Grasping
evidence_anchors: Abstract and Secs.I-IV pp.1-4; Sec.V and Table III pp.8-9; Secs.VI-VII Table IV pp.10-11; Appendix p.13
reviewer_notes: Real-robot closed-loop grasping, disturbance, and re-grasping tests support utility and limited safety. World-state/transition fidelity and uncertainty calibration are not directly evaluated.

title: X-WIN: Building Chest Radiograph World Model via Predictive Sensing
evidence_anchors: Architecture and predictive action pp.1-4; Sec.4 Tables 1-4 pp.5-7; Table 5 p.8
reviewer_notes: The action is a known simulated imaging rotation, not treatment. Spatial next-view prediction and downstream transfer are evaluated, but there is no recursive rollout or frozen clinical external validation.

title: Xray2Xray: World Model from Chest X-rays with Volumetric Context
evidence_anchors: Abstract and Secs.1-2 pp.1-5; Sec.3 Tables 1-3 and Figs.2-3 pp.5-8; Conclusion pp.8-9
reviewer_notes: Thirty-six recursive geometric projections support free-running use, but no angle-resolved drift is reported. Direction tokens are not ablated, and external radiographs require domain adaptation.

title: medDreamer: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning with Latent Imagination on Complex EHRs for Clinical Decision Support
evidence_anchors: Abstract and Introduction pp.1-3; Sec.3 pp.3-8; Sec.4 Tables 1-2 and Figs.2-8 pp.8-13; appendices pp.18-19
reviewer_notes: The model free-runs for policy imagination, but direct state/transition validation is weak. Mortality claims rest on OPE without confounding or overlap analysis; reported sepsis intervals and split details need checking.
